_comment_1: Provenance metadata for the vendored CTH v0.3 schema (sibling file inventory.schema.v0.3.json). See docs/cth/README.md §Refresh procedure for how to update both files in tandem.
_comment_2: JSON has no inline comment support, so this metadata lives in a sibling .meta.json file rather than as a header in the schema file itself. The CI workflow (.github/workflows/cth-schema-lint.yml) only reads the schema file; this meta file is purely informational for audit + refresh purposes.
vendored_by_pr: QBP cth/vendored-schema-0.3.4-sync (PR number filled at open; prior: #621 for 0.3.3, #549 for 0.3.2)
synced_from_upstream_pr: 0.3.4: confluent-trust#104 (four-bucket schema delta — decision_state open|settled + kill_condition array<object> KillConditionEntry + OpenNeedsKill + the four QBP-local root lists promoted to $defs), merged by the beekeeper 2026-09-20; upstream-first per R16. Prior: 0.3.3 derivation delta (#621); 0.3.2 confluent-trust#98.
_comment_semver: schema_document_semver mirrors x-schema-semver in the vendored schema's $id (0.3.3). This is the load-bearing primitive the Toddle drift-check + Walk pin-by-reference key on (cth-qbp-live-testing seq 29-33). Distinct from cth_schema_version (the v0.3 generation) and the inventory content version. Cumulative minor/additive fields: 0.3.1 — killed_by/killed_note/review_flag (#93), foundation_batch (#96), class_floors (contextus PR #32 Q1); 0.3.2 — axis_trust/locale_domain/cluster_state (sheaf trust, #95/inter#41 Decision 2); 0.3.3 — derivation provenance_kind + relaxed C1 (verification-fields allowed on {proof, derivation}), FAULT-S4-007 / #621; 0.3.4 — decision_state (open|settled; 'settled' not 'ruled': reached by proof/force, per the derived-not-ruled principle) + kill_condition as array<object> KillConditionEntry {kill (required, non-placeholder), closure ∈ {derivation|measurement|ruling-rescope} (required), discharge (required iff closure ∈ {derivation, measurement})} + OpenNeedsKill invariant + meta_principles/interpretations/retired_axioms/retired_principles as $defs (confluent-trust#104, QBP #654 D3, #662 records as test vector).
lean_toolchain_compatible_with: leanprover/lean4:v4.30.0-rc2 (compatible — schema is toolchain-independent; this field documents the QBP-side compatibility check at vendoring time)
refresh_procedure: See docs/cth/README.md §Refresh procedure. On each refresh: (1) re-copy schema, (2) re-compute sha256 and update this file, (3) update vendored_on_date_utc, (4) update vendored_upstream_commit_sha, (5) verify .github/workflows/cth-schema-lint.yml still passes against current archive/cth-inventory/*.json, (6) update QBP PR number that performed the refresh.
